title: Delivered Grain Bonus on the Season Volume Discount, Crop Input Purchasing Accounts
content:
A member who sells grain to the cooperative under Grain Marketing Contracts as well as buying their inputs here carries a bonus on the volume discount rate on their crop input account, and the bonus is read from the contract they hold and from the bushels the cooperative has taken in from them.

**The bonus.** Where the member holds a live grain marketing contract with the cooperative and the net bushels the cooperative has taken in from them over the 14 statement months before the handling date, counted after the moisture shrink taken at unload as the scale tickets record them, are at or above 25000 bushels, the delivered grain bonus added to the volume discount rate is 0.50 percent. Where the member holds a live grain marketing contract with the cooperative and those net bushels are below 25000, the delivered grain bonus is 0.25 percent. In every other case no delivered grain bonus is added on the Crop Input Purchasing Accounts.

## The two conditions, read together

| A live grain marketing contract | Net bushels taken in over the 14 statement months, after the moisture shrink taken at unload | Delivered grain bonus |
| --- | --- | --- |
| held | 25000 or more | 0.50 percent |
| held | fewer than 25000 | 0.25 percent |
| not held | any | none added |

The bushels the bonus is read from are the net bushels the cooperative has taken in from the member under Grain Marketing Contracts and applied to delivery over that window, counted after the moisture shrink taken at unload as the scale tickets record them, whatever the commodity or the crop year of the contract they came in against. A member standing at 24999 net bushels is below the volume the bonus turns on; a member standing at 25000 net bushels has reached it.
